fit_part: live frames 2026-10-24T21 to 2026-10-29T04 UTC, 2026-10-28 dropped; mid-marked (docs/research/paper-quoter.md at commit 0a66bfb)

shared.scope: thin markets (under 1,000 contracts a day over their days open in the span), every category unless the rule names one, mid or standing price between 3 and 97 cents, markets closing within 7 days of the quote
shared.quote_life: from the frame to the market's next frame or its close
shared.fill_rule: a taker trade strictly after the frame and strictly beyond the paper quote fills it for the smaller of the size and the trade's size; one fill a quote and side; block trades never

bar.interval: cluster bootstrap over (event, day), 2.5% each side, 2,000 resamples

shared.test_part: the live days after this registration, at least seven whole UTC days with the ingest up; a day with a logged outage over ten minutes leaves the part; read once, outcomes included
